points.description: States at least 4 valid objectives of IPv6, e.g. support billions of end-systems; reduce routing tables; simplified header for faster protocol processing; better security; support real-time traffic/quality of service (flow label, traffic class); multicasting; mobility/roaming; extensibility via extension headers; coexistence with existing protocols. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only 2 or 3 valid objectives are given.

rubric.notes: Full mark for at least 4 correct IPv6 objectives in any wording. Half mark for 2–3 correct objectives. No marks for fewer than 2 or for incorrect objectives.
